results.title: Black Swan
results.overview: A committed dancer struggles to maintain her sanity after winning the lead role in a production of Tchaikovsky's "Swan Lake."

results.title: The Black Swan
results.overview: When notorious pirate Henry Morgan is made governor of Jamaica, he enlists the help of some of his former partners in ridding the Caribbean of buccaneers. When one of them apparently abducts the previous governor's pretty daughter and joins up with the rebels, things are set for a fight.

results.name: Black Swan Lake
results.overview:
A young woman is kidnapped. Her belongings are delivered one after the other. Shota Zaizen is the CEO of Zaizen Corporation. He remembers a similar case 18 years ago, when he worked as a researcher at a private detective agency. That case involved a client's daughter who was kidnapped by a man named Tanioka and the victim's personal belongings like underwear, fingernails, pictures were delivered to the father. Shota Zaizen is shaken, because he found success by using that case from 18 years ago. Everything he has now is thanks to that case. The perpetrator Tanioka was never caught.

Now, Shota Zaizen's 18-year-old daughter Mika goes missing. Mika's belongings are delivered to Shota Zaizen. Shota Zaizen carries out an investigation by himself. He also discovers about his wife Yuko's past.

results.name: The Black Swan
results.overview: A female lawyer with connections to much of the Danish underworld decides to break away from her old environment. She becomes a mole for a group of journalists, and with a hidden camera, she starts exposing everything from bikers to lawyers and major businesspeople.

known_for.title: Night of the Coconut
known_for.overview: Charl: an adorable googly-eyed coconut turned pop culture sensation who is secretly a genocidal robot from another universe. In 5 days he’s going to murder the entire planet, and the only people who might be able to stop him are a multiverse-hopping law enforcement officer and a failed author obsessed with cartoons. The season finale of the long-running Charl storyline on the Patrick (H) Willems channel.

results.title: Black Swan Story
results.overview: Black Swan Story follows Joel Pott, singer with British indie rock band Athlete, retracing his grandfathers footsteps in Arnhem. Joel's Grandfather, Major John Pott was a British Paratrooper who fought in The Battle of Arnhem, World War 2. His mission was to reach the bridge at Arnhem, which his brother Major John Frost was heroically holding against tremendous odds (he was played by Anthony Hopkins in the film 'A Bridge Too Far'). But Major John Pott was shot en-route. As he lay there wounded he wrote a letter home to his wife. This documentary film, packed with great music from Athlete, follows Joel and his father David on an emotional road trip of discovery.

results.title: The Black Swan
results.overview: Janko Labud, a young and cunning bank manager, comes to work in a small provincial bank, replacing his predecessor who commited suicide under mysterious circumstances. However, immediately after his arrival, he'll get roped into a series of complicated conspiracies orchestrated by the county prefect Anica Kralj.

results.title: The Robbers and the Black Swan
results.overview: In the autumn of 1949, during the peaceful liberation of Xinjiang, General Jiang, commander of the Kuomintang garrison in Xinjiang, saw that the situation was lost. He secretly ordered his deputy, Feng Ziqiao, to escort his wife Gina and a shipment of treasures abroad. Gina sought out a White Russian officer named Vasily and conspired with him to seize the treasures for themselves. Feng Ziqiao hired a local named Rexiti as a guide, planning to disguise the group as a trading caravan heading abroad.

results.title: Kabukicho Black Swan Cabaret Club / AV / Dark Woman Arranger -Miyuki-

results.overview: Aika (Ruka Kanae) has shaken off the persistent scoutman who called out to her in Shinjuku Kabukicho. I thought I was relieved when I ran away, but behind me called out, "Don't you want a job that can earn more money than you do now?" and when I turned around, I saw a beautiful woman there. She was a very successful female scout in Kabukicho, Fukayuki (Ai Sayama).

results.name: The Dark Side - The Black Swan
results.overview: Experienced crime reporters Carsten Norton and Janni Pedersen from TV 2's crime magazine 'Skyggesiden' enlighten viewers about the revelations in the documentary 'The Black Swan'.

results.overview: "A Black Swan Stomps on an Oversized Human Heart" follows Heinrich, a lonely young man in an empty castle, through his strained, detached conversations with Hannah, an analogy on the isolation and miscommunication that define modern love in a fast-paced world.
